//Development: Development defaults, fit for deployed dev: no loopback address, local path or local switch. A local run's own values come from the https launch profile (Catalogue:TrustedOrigins:0, the Vite dev server https://localhost:8282 writing through its /api proxy) and the gitignored appsettings.Local.json, which only that profile (LOCAL_SETTINGS=true) reads: ConnectionStrings:Database (a local PostgreSQL; a local run creates the database and applies the catalogue set), Catalogue:SourceRoot (the read-only mft products folder the empty-store seed and Import read), Catalogue:OrganizationId (the local Identity organization whose members sign in) and Identity:Client (the local Identity at https://localhost:8404: Authority, ClientId, ClientSecret, CookieName).
